title: HubException
description: A single diagnostic entry in the redlineDB hub exception catalog. Matches crates/hub/src/exceptions.rs::HubException and db/migrations/001_hub_exceptions.sql.

id.description: Unique ERR_* identifier matching the catalog constant.

purpose.description: One-line human-readable description of what this exception guards.

reason.description: Why this exception fires — the triggering condition.

common_fixes.description: Ordered list of repair actions an agent or maintainer should try.

docs_url.description: Relative path to the documentation page for this exception (relative to repo root).

repair_hint.description: Machine-parseable single repair hint in 'run: <cmd>' or 'grep <pattern> <file>' form.

examples.reason: a required CLI tool was not found on PATH
common_fixes: install the missing tool per docs/testing.md#prerequisites
